sampling: All original test rationales with complete mappings and supported proposed diagnosis; no outcome selection, no full-probe correctness restriction
direction_semantics: COHD: full-input leave-group-out probability difference; local SHAP: group-summed raw class-logit attribution, not probability change; class SHAP: class mean absolute attribution, unsigned
controls: same direction and same actual changed fact count; exclude high-selected group; sample with replacement; no fallback
high: maximum directional magnitude over legal candidates; lexical group tie-break
low: minimum magnitude among same-count same-direction alternatives, lexical tie-break; ties retained
epsilon_role: numerical zero only, not clinical threshold
group_scope: add all observed missing members, delete all cited members; context held fixed
g0_acceptance: contracts, exact-count matching, timing and explicit unavailability; not positive effect or significance
future_G1_metric: high intervention effect minus mean ten matched random effects, within-patient averaging then patient bootstrap500
future_G2: fixed patient, d, operation and changed count; B0/B1/B2/B3 scores exported, B4 requires separate freeze before G2
